description: Source code for a Perl module 'DiffHighlight' that provides diff highlighting functionality, including color configuration, line handling, and diff visualization.

methods.name: visible_width
methods.description: Calculates the visible width of a string excluding terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring omitting a specified number of visible characters, ignoring color sequences.

methods.name: handle_line
methods.description: Processes a line of diff output, handling graph lines, hunks, and diff content.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes queued diff hunks for display.

methods.name: highlight_stdin
methods.description: Reads diff lines from STDIN and processes them for highlighting.

methods.name: color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration from git or defaults.

methods.name: show_hunk
methods.description: Displays a diff hunk with highlighting.

methods.name: split_line
methods.description: Splits a line into tokens, considering color sequences.

methods.name: highlight_line
methods.description: Highlights a specific line segment based on theme.

methods.name: is_pair_interesting
methods.description: Determines if a pair of lines has meaningful differences worth highlighting.
